metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: grade
plugins.description: Strict, evidence-driven software quality audit. Multi-domain scoring anchored to ISO/IEC 25010 (McCabe, NIST, SonarQube, OWASP). Full + diff modes, trend tracking, divergent-path findings, multi-language.

plugins.name: rationalize
plugins.description: Divergent-path analysis and convergence planning for duplicated workflows, contracts, APIs, schemas, services, UI paths, tests, and legacy/current code paths.

plugins.name: bug-scrub
plugins.description: Evidence-driven bug scrub for repositories and diffs, with optional bounded subagent analysis for large codebases.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Codex code review closeout helper for local patches, PR branches, and parallel verification.

plugins.name: pr-delivery
plugins.description: End-to-end pull request delivery workflow for commit, push, PR creation, CI/review monitoring, safe merge, target-branch post-merge CI verification, and cleanup.

plugins.name: recursive-plan-review
plugins.description: Iterative plan-file critique and refinement that applies evidence-backed improvements until no actionable comments remain.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Repository-native release execution and release-infrastructure remediation through gates, tags, artifacts, and publication checks.

plugins.name: frontend-pr-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous frontend/UI improvement loop that chooses a bounded change, verifies it, delivers it through a merged PR, verifies target-branch post-merge CI, rebuilds running app containers, and rechecks.

plugins.name: grade-loop
plugins.description: End-to-end quality remediation loop that grades a repo, reviews a remediation plan, implements a bounded fix, delivers the PR, verifies target-branch post-merge CI, rebuilds running app containers, and reruns grade.

plugins.name: rationalize-loop
plugins.description: End-to-end convergence remediation loop that rationalizes divergent paths, reviews a convergence plan, implements a bounded phase, delivers the PR, verifies target-branch post-merge CI, rebuilds running app containers, and reruns rationalize.

plugins.name: implement-merge
plugins.description: Plan-to-merge execution loop that implements the newest plan in bounded phases, delivers each phase with pr-delivery, and rebuilds already-running containers after completion.
